description: NaWInO₆Sn crystallizes in the cubic F̅43m space group. The structure consists of four Sn clusters inside a NaWInO₆ framework. In each Sn cluster, Sn is bonded in a 12-coordinate geometry to  atoms. In the NaWInO₆ framework, Na is bonded to twelve equivalent O atoms to form NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent WO₆ octahedra, and faces with four equivalent InO₆ octahedra. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.89 Å. W is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form WO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent InO₆ octahedra and faces with four equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All W-O bond lengths are 1.94 Å. In is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form InO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent WO₆ octahedra and faces with four equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All In-O bond lengths are 2.14 Å. O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to two equivalent Na, one W, and one In atom.
